**In one line**: OpenAI has reportedly delayed the release of a new model, "Astra," over cybersecurity concerns.

### Key points
- According to The Economic Times, OpenAI paused the rollout of an AI model reported as "Astra."
- The stated reason is "critical" cybersecurity concerns.
- Specific risk details and a timeline for resuming release have not been disclosed.

### Why it matters
A frontier developer voluntarily slowing a launch over safety issues highlights the tension between capability racing and security review. If confirmed, it signals that pre-deployment risk assessment — red-teaming and safety review — is beginning to shape actual release schedules. Details remain to be verified.
